title: WCS page: anchor on a circle's centre (pick a circular edge), as a reusable pick, and tidy the page layout

labels.name: in-review
labels.description: Fix pushed on a branch with an open PR; merges at the next cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Reported by the maintainer while hand-testing the WCS page (screenshot in chat: X/Y/Z origin, Tilt/Turn fields, quarter-turn buttons, "Anchor on" Stock box with Bottom/Middle/Top, "Pick markers in viewport", and the NW…SE grid).

## 1. Anchor on the centre of a circle

Today the WCS can be anchored on a grid point of the stock box or the model's bounds (NW…SE × Bottom/Middle/Top, or picked markers). Add **anchoring on the centre of a circle**, e.g. a hole or a boss: pick a circular (or arc) edge and the WCS origin goes to its centre (the circle's centre point, at the edge's height; the circle's axis is available for later use).

- **Reusable.** Build "circle centre from a picked edge" as a shared pick primitive in the app layer, next to the pick graph (#692 / `pick`), not inside the WCS page. Other tools will reuse it: setup alignment (#738), WCS roles (#701), probing, hole features. It should take an edge pick and return the centre, axis and radius, or a named refusal when the edge isn't circular within tolerance (a straight edge, a spline, an open polyline that doesn't fit a circle). Never return a guessed centre.
- **On the page:** a separate group under "Anchor on", cleanly separated from the stock-box/model grid. For example an "Anchor on: Stock box / Model / **Circle centre**" choice, where Circle centre shows "Pick a circular edge" plus the picked result ("Circle Ø 8.00 mm, centre (x, y, z)").
- **Undoable command** like the other WCS edits, with its MCP tool (AGENTS.md "Commands ship with an MCP tool"), or a filed `MCP: ...` follow-up.

## 2. Layout: the page is cluttered

- **Value fields:** label and input on **one row**, with the inputs aligned in a column (a two-column grid: "X origin [ 0.0 mm ]"). Today each input drops below its label.
- **Quarter-turn buttons** (Turn X+ … Turn Z-, Level, Set Origin): same size, filling the pane's width in an even grid, rather than leaving a ragged right edge.
- **Anchor grid** (NW N NE / W [C] E / SW S SE): equal-size buttons, a bit larger, centred or filling the pane's width, so it reads as a 3×3 compass.
- Group the page into clear sections (Origin and orientation · Quarter turns · Anchor on), so the circle-centre option sits in its own group.

## Related
- #692: one pick rule and pick API (circle-centre builds on its feature edges).
- #701: set the WCS from picked features with roles.
- #738: setup-page alignment and pick visibility (reuses the circle-centre pick).

## Done means
- Picking a circular edge on the WCS page sets the origin to the circle's centre. Pinned by an app test on a mesh with a drilled hole, comparing the centre to the true one within tolerance, plus a test that a straight edge is refused by name, plus undo restoring the previous origin.
- The circle-centre function lives in a shared module with its own tests and is called from the WCS page, not written inside it.
- The layout changes are checked by the structural assertions (labels and fields on one row, buttons present and enabled), with no snapshot PNG changes in the PR.
- An MCP tool for the new anchor exists, or a follow-up issue is filed.
